comment: No family on the two jacks: what they carry changes with the switch, a gate in the CV position and a bipolar voltage in the V/OCT position. The maker's manual describes the CV position backwards, saying 1.7V in gives 1.7V out; the source gives 0V for an input at or above 1.7V and 1.7V for anything below, which is what an inverter does and what is written here.
